conflict_result.affects_qqq_postfix_status_note: QQQ's frozen Gold v0.2 contract defines NO rule (no COMPOSITE_STRUCTURE_HIT hit_type exists for QQQ, unlike NVDA/AMD/TSM) that gates PASS/FAIL/REVIEW on a specific main-conflict family. residual_imprecision_found.description: All 4 final surviving matched_alpha=A001 claims were re-inspected and found to still be, on their own text, either negations of a rate-cut ('prices at 0%', 'has been removed as a tailwind... replaced by a hike-risk headwind', '"No cuts in 2026" at 93%... Removes the... tailwind') or a speculative, hypothetical retail-tweet aside ('the black swan will be when they finally cut rates... but... rates spike over 10%') -- none are genuine positive-easing assertions. Root cause identified by direct inspection of comqutor_alpha.structure_engine.claim_semantics.classify_a001_directional_semantics: (1) the DIRECT_POSITIVE branch does not check for simple negation words ('removed', 'dead', 'ended') the way it checks for hedging/modal language, so 'Rate Cut Cycle...has been removed' still matches the bare 'rate cut cycle' phrase; (2) the NEGATIVE_OR_HAWKISH pattern requires 'no (fed )?rate cuts?' but this run's phrasing is bare 'No cuts in 2026' (without the word 'rate' immediately adjacent), so it is not caught; (3) the conditional/modal word list (if/unless/could/may/might/would/potentially) does not cover 'will...when' hypothetical framing or prediction-market 'prices at 0%' negation framing.
residual_imprecision_found.impact_on_this_acceptance_determination: NONE -- per Gold's frozen acceptance rule, PASS/FAIL is determined by A001's final detected LEVEL, not by the precision of every individual claim classification. The residual 4 claims (down from ~50 that were ever LLM-selected as A001 before either gate) reduced evidence_quality (raw 7.81 vs historical 97.73) and agent_independence (2 agents vs historical 7) so far that the final score (26.65) stayed far below any detection threshold. The remediation achieved its intended product effect on this run despite the residual classifier imprecision.
